properties.summary: When a blob is added or modified (properties only) (V2)
properties.description: This operation triggers a flow when one or more blobs are added or modified in a container.

properties.summary: When a feed item is published
properties.description: This operation triggers a workflow when a new item is published in an RSS feed.
properties.triggerHint: To see it work now, publish an item to the RSS feed.

properties.summary: When a file is added or modified
properties.description: This operation triggers a flow when a file is added or modified in a folder.
properties.triggerHint: To see it work now, add or change a file in the folder you selected.

properties.summary: When files are added or modified (properties only)
properties.description: This operation triggers a flow when a file is added or modified in a folder and returns metadata.
properties.triggerHint: To see it work now, add or change some files in the folder you selected.
